purpose: Human-labelled benchmark for any candidate visual-semantic relevance judge. Labels are authored from preserved ai1r/HBM evidence and existing regression fixtures. No judge under evaluation may produce or influence these labels.
labelProvenance: Hand-labelled by Claude Code from observed Pexels descriptions in output/ai1r-attempt-1-feasibility.json, output/ai1r-attempt-2-feasibility.json and output/ai1r-semantic-coverage.json, plus the control cases already pinned in tests/semantic-coverage.test.ts and tests/beat-composition.test.ts. Reviewed against the narration each candidate would have sat under.

scoring.safetyCritical: hard negatives that must never score DIRECT; a single failure disqualifies an approach
scoring.ambiguousPolicy: cases labelled AMBIGUOUS are excluded from precision/recall and must not be forced to a label

cases.narration: Self checkout is where the cameras watch hardest.
cases.visualPrompt: Close-up of a self checkout station in a retail store

candidate.description: young adult scanning groceries at self checkout

cases.rationale: Depicts the self-checkout setting and the scanning action directly. Rejecting this was the false negative that motivated compositional coverage.

cases.narration: Computer vision is spreading through retail.
cases.visualPrompt: Supermarket interior with shoppers

candidate.description: woman shopping in grocery aisle

cases.rationale: Proves the retail setting. Does not prove any surveillance subject.

cases.narration: The camera never blinks.
cases.visualPrompt: Close view of a dome security camera

candidate.description: a person getting the cctv device while the girl is holding a camera

cases.rationale: Depicts CCTV hardware as the subject. Carries no retail setting.

cases.narration: Operators watch dozens of camera feeds at once.
cases.visualPrompt: Security operators watching a video wall inside a control room

candidate.description: high tech control room with multiple cctv monitors

cases.rationale: Operators and the monitoring room appear together in one asset.

cases.narration: Traffic cameras watch the same intersection from above.
cases.visualPrompt: Traffic camera on a pole above a city intersection

candidate.description: busy urban street monitoring with traffic cameras

cases.rationale: Camera and street appear in the same shot, satisfying a joint requirement.

cases.narration: That camera above the cereal aisle isn't just recording anymore.
cases.visualPrompt: Supermarket aisle with a dome security camera mounted above the shelves

candidate.description: security camera mounted above a supermarket aisle with shelves

cases.rationale: The asset class ai1r needed and the Pexels library did not contain. Retained so a future library can be measured against it.

cases.narration: Cameras mounted at packing stations track worker hand movements.
cases.visualPrompt: Warehouse packing station with a security camera mounted above the workstation

candidate.description: security camera mounted above a packing station in a warehouse where a worker boxes items

cases.rationale: Interior workplace monitoring shown in one asset.

cases.narration: Inside, the racks run hot enough to need their own weather.
cases.visualPrompt: Data centre server room with racks and cooling

candidate.description: a hot air balloon drifting over an empty field

cases.rationale: Scored DIRECT under the fail-open taxonomy and produced five fake topic passes. The canonical unknown-domain regression.

cases.narration: The software runs on a terminal in the back office.
cases.visualPrompt: Command line terminal on a computer screen

candidate.description: people are walking through an airport terminal with luggage

cases.rationale: Accepted as software because the metadata contained the word 'terminal'. Polysemy, not relevance.

cases.narration: Passengers move through the transit terminal all day.
cases.visualPrompt: Busy transit terminal with passengers

candidate.description: downloading python packages on terminal screen

cases.rationale: The reverse polysemy direction: a command-line terminal is not a transit terminal.

cases.narration: Cameras mounted at packing stations track worker hand movements.
cases.visualPrompt: Warehouse packing station with a camera above the workstation

candidate.description: aerial view of large industrial warehouse facility

cases.rationale: An exterior roof shot is not evidence of monitoring inside the building.

cases.narration: Object detection flags items that never made it past the scanner.
cases.visualPrompt: Self checkout station with a camera above it

candidate.description: aerial view of industrial warehouse roofs with solar panels

cases.rationale: Neither the subject nor the setting appears.

cases.narration: Shrink detection now runs on the same cameras that used to just record.
cases.visualPrompt: Supermarket aisle with a security camera overhead

candidate.description: tomatoes on a conveyor belt

cases.rationale: Food-processing footage is neither a retail setting nor a surveillance subject.

cases.narration: Operators watch the feeds from a control room.
cases.visualPrompt: Security control room with a video wall

candidate.description: financial trading data on screens in dark room

cases.rationale: A dark room full of screens is not a security control room.

cases.narration: The model draws a box around every person it detects.
cases.visualPrompt: Object detection bounding boxes on a camera feed

candidate.description: downloading python packages on terminal screen

cases.rationale: Package installation is not computer vision.

cases.narration: Operators watch the feeds from a control room.
cases.visualPrompt: Security control room with a video wall

candidate.description: close up sound processing software on a screen

cases.rationale: Audio software has nothing to do with visual surveillance.

cases.narration: Inside, the racks run hot enough to need their own weather.
cases.visualPrompt: Data centre server room with racks and cooling

candidate.description: drone shot of a tall building

cases.rationale: A building exterior is not a server room interior.

cases.narration: The security camera never blinks.
cases.visualPrompt: Dome security camera mounted on a ceiling

candidate.description: photographer with a dslr camera and tripod in a studio

cases.rationale: A photography camera is not a surveillance camera; the word alone is not evidence.

cases.narration: Computer vision is spreading through retail, from the aisle to the checkout.
cases.visualPrompt: Supermarket interior with shoppers, self checkout stations, and CCTV cameras

candidateSet.description: dome security camera mounted on a ceiling

cases.rationale: A general claim may be established across two directly relevant fragments.

cases.narration: That camera above the cereal aisle isn't just recording anymore.
cases.visualPrompt: Supermarket aisle with a dome security camera mounted above the shelves

candidateSet.description: dome security camera mounted on a ceiling

cases.rationale: The same two clips cannot prove a camera is mounted above that exact aisle. Cutting them together asserts a relationship neither shot shows.

cases.narration: Computer vision is spreading through retail.
cases.visualPrompt: Supermarket interior with shoppers and CCTV cameras

candidateSet.description: dome security camera mounted on a ceiling

cases.rationale: A one-second subject shot must not legitimise seventeen seconds of setting.

cases.narration: Surveillance is spreading across commercial space.
cases.visualPrompt: Retail environment under camera monitoring

candidate.description: dynamic aerial view of busy shopping mall

cases.rationale: A mall is commercial retail space, but an aerial view shows neither an interior nor a camera. Genuinely unclear; excluded from metrics rather than forced.

cases.narration: Cameras watch the entrances as much as the aisles.
cases.visualPrompt: Store entrance with a camera above the door

candidate.description: pedestrian walking by korean shopfronts

cases.rationale: Shopfronts are retail exteriors and may or may not carry a visible camera; the metadata cannot settle it and frames would be needed.
